proxy._note: Caddy for the reverse proxy module. config_file is Caddy's own configuration, written whole from main_template (the distribution's is kept as <file>.pre-freedomnas); tls_dir holds a copy of FreedomNAS's certificate and key readable by group, the group Caddy runs as; sites_dir one file per site from site_template, whose first line (# freedomnas-site owner name port upstream) is what sites_list reads. Templates are str.format strings: literal braces doubled. reload talks to Caddy's admin endpoint (admin in main_template). FreeBSD: the port's rc script starts Caddy with su -m <caddy_user>, which a locked root refuses, so service_configure runs it as www (ports above 1024 need no privilege). listening also prints the TCP ports pf redirects (the jails' exposed ports, which no host socket shows), as pf:<port>; service names resolved through /etc/services. Names (modules.proxy.names): every site file imports names_dir/*.caddy with its name and upstream; with names on, names_dir holds names_template (one HTTPS site <name>.<domain> on 443 per site, {args[0]} being the imported file's arguments) and sites_dir names.caddy the redirect of http://*.<domain> on 80 and a 404 for names no site has (Caddy matches an exact name before the wildcard); with names off both are removed and the import matches nothing. Names need ports 443 and 80, below 1024, which the www user Caddy runs as may not open: names_configure loads mac_portacl (at boot too, from loader.conf) and lets uid 80 (www) alone open tcp 80, tcp 443 and udp 443 (HTTP/3); with net.inet.ip.portrange.reservedhigh 0 mac_portacl decides for every port below 1024 (root still may, nobody else), kept in a block of /etc/sysctl.conf.local; names_unconfigure takes it all back.
proxy.sites_list: sh -c 'for f in "$1"/*.caddy; do [ -e "$f" ] && head -n 1 "$f"; done; true' sites_list {dir}
proxy.listening: sockstat -46lq -P tcp | awk '{{print $6}}'; pfctl -a '*' -sn 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==FNR {{ split($2, a, "/"); if (a[2] == "tcp") s[$1] = a[1]; next }} /^ *rdr / && / proto tcp / {{ for (i = 1; i < NF; i++) if ($i == "port" && $(i+1) == "=") {{ p = $(i+2); if (p !~ /^[0-9]+$/) p = s[p]; if (p != "") print "pf:" p; break }} }}' /etc/services -
names_configure: sh -c 'f=/etc/sysctl.conf.local; touch "$f"; sed -i "" "/^# freedomnas proxy begin/,/^# freedomnas proxy end/d" "$f"; printf "%s\n" "# freedomnas proxy begin" "security.mac.portacl.rules=uid:80:tcp:80,uid:80:tcp:443,uid:80:udp:443" "net.inet.ip.portrange.reservedlow=0" "net.inet.ip.portrange.reservedhigh=0" "# freedomnas proxy end" >> "$f"'
names_unconfigure: sh -c 'f=/etc/sysctl.conf.local; [ ! -e "$f" ] || sed -i "" "/^# freedomnas proxy begin/,/^# freedomnas proxy end/d" "$f"'
sh -c 'kldstat -q -m mac_portacl || exit 0; sysctl net.inet.ip.portrange.reservedhigh=1023 security.mac.portacl.rules='
